name: xcom-enhanced-gallery
description: Desktop media gallery and original-quality downloader for X.com.
author: PiesP

scripts.build:extension: vp build --config vite.extension.config.ts && vp build --config vite.extension.cs.config.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check/extension-build.ts dist-extension
scripts.build:extension:firefox: vp build --config vite.extension.firefox.config.ts && vp build --config vite.extension.firefox.cs.config.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check/extension-build.ts dist-extension-firefox
scripts.build:all: pnpm -s build:ci && pnpm -s build:extension:ci && pnpm -s build:extension:firefox:ci
scripts.build:extension:ci: vp build --config vite.extension.config.ts && vp build --config vite.extension.cs.config.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check/extension-build.ts dist-extension
scripts.build:extension:firefox:ci: vp build --config vite.extension.firefox.config.ts && vp build --config vite.extension.firefox.cs.config.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check/extension-build.ts dist-extension-firefox
scripts.build:e2e: pnpm clean && pnpm build:ci && pnpm build:dev && pnpm build:extension:ci && pnpm build:extension:firefox:ci
scripts.check:scripts: tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node-tests.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.windows.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm -s check:src && pnpm -s check:tooling && pnpm -s check:test && pnpm -s check:scripts
scripts.quality: pnpm -s fmt && pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s check && pnpm -s check:e2e && pnpm -s test:ci
scripts.quality:coverage-owned: pnpm -s fmt && pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s check && pnpm -s check:e2e && pnpm -s test:policy
scripts.quality:fix: pnpm -s fmt:fix && pnpm -s lint:fix && pnpm -s quality
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm test:cov:after-policy && pnpm build:dev && pnpm -s test:e2e:all
scripts.test:e2e:all: pnpm -s test:e2e && pnpm -s test:e2e:extension && pnpm -s test:e2e:extension:firefox && pnpm -s test:e2e:native
